descriptionHtml:
Dominate modern games and demanding workloads with the Lenovo LOQ 15IRX10! Driven by a high-performance 13th Gen Intel Core i7 HX-series processor, next-generation NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 8GB graphics, and a vibrant 100% sRGB 144Hz display, this laptop delivers exceptional speed, fidelity, and reliability.
